# Navimower Map Card 0.3.3

Navimower Map Card 0.3.3 promotes the field-tested 0.3.3-beta1 mower-artwork fix to the latest stable release.

## Fixed

- Correct the manual `mower_icon: i_dark` artwork so it renders properly.
- Rebuild the dark i-series artwork directly from the supplied original 60 px source asset (`16076.svg`, 85x120).
- Preserve the source asset's transparent embedded PNG instead of the earlier WebP conversion.
- Keep mower size normalization, heading rotation, automatic model detection and all other mower artwork unchanged.

## Packaging

- Continue shipping one HACS runtime file: `navimower-map-card.js`.
- Keep `src/navimower-map-card.js` and `dist/navimower-map-card.js` byte-for-byte identical after the build.
- No separate SVG, PNG, loader or temporary helper assets are added to the release tree.

This stable release contains the same runtime behavior that was verified in 0.3.3-beta1, with only the prerelease version markers promoted to 0.3.3.
